reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin through claims of unlimited income, rapid currency growth, and large earnings while explicitly tying income to recommendations and building a structure of people. It encourages participation with a signup link, a button labeled “I want to earn money,” and instructions to register and become a partner, rather than presenting the claims as criticism or analysis.

citations.quote: This project offers a unique bonus plan with which it took only 9 months for 330 people to be able to earn 350 USD per week.
money from recommendation, it means for building the structure of people
The biggest advantage is the unlimited source of income and the financial freedom.
Click at the button under the video I want to earn money you'll be redirected to a form where you only need to fill in your name and email address where we will send you information what to do next.
Enter our program now and join more than 430,000 partners

opening.argument: The presentation includes an explicit qualification that participants should be aware of both benefits and risks, and it rejects the idea that everyone will make hundreds of thousands overnight. That language is materially different from a guaranteed-return pitch: it acknowledges uncertainty and says the opportunity is for people deciding whether to run a business. The offer also provides a free registration and a 10-day trial period, allowing viewers to decide whether to participate actively. These are cautionary conditions and an opportunity to evaluate the service, not proof that the promotion deceptively guarantees earnings.

why will definitely not tell you that everybody can and hundreds of thousands of euro overnight in this company
Registration is for free, then you will have a 10-day trial period during which you can decide if you want to join us actively.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution emphasizes earnings language and the call to action, but those points do not erase the qualification that benefits and risks should be considered. Its quoted phrases also do not establish that earnings are guaranteed or that payment is required. The registration language describes a free trial and an opportunity to decide, while the presentation expressly rejects overnight riches.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A disclaimer does not change the video's dominant invitation to join and earn money. The qualification still follows claims of a bonus plan, extraordinary monthly income, and an unlimited income source. Most importantly, the described compensation includes recommendation income from building a structure of people, and viewers are told to become partners. A free registration or trial can reduce friction without making the recruitment model ordinary commerce.

opening.argument: The material can reasonably be understood as an educational explanation of a cryptocurrency project and its operating features. It describes how income is divided, identifies an internal exchange, discusses a crypto casino and a gold-backed coin, and offers video manuals and know-how from cryptocurrency professionals. That is explanatory product information about a financial technology and its associated services. The presence of a registration pathway does not by itself convert an informational presentation into a scam, especially where the content explains the project and gives viewers a trial period to decide whether to participate.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution treats every explanatory detail as solicitation, but describing a cryptocurrency's exchange, casino, educational materials, and income structures is consistent with a product overview. Its call-to-action quote shows a registration route, not that the video misrepresents the product. The quoted earnings example is presented as what happened to particular people, not as a promise that every viewer will obtain the same result.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The instructional details are embedded in a direct recruitment pitch, not a detached tutorial. The video asks viewers to click an earnings button, submit contact information, become partners, and join more than 430,000 partners. Its explanation of recommendation income specifically describes building a people structure, so the educational framing does not remove the central recruitment mechanism.

opening.argument: The offer is framed as a business and service package involving a cryptocurrency, an internal exchange, educational access, and an online casino. The supplied material does not state that viewers must make a deposit, does not show a guaranteed return, and does not explain that income is available solely through recruiting others. Instead, it distinguishes recommendation income from money associated with trading the currency in an internal exchange. The free registration and 10-day trial further resemble ordinary customer or partner onboarding. The material therefore supports a commercial promotion, but does not by itself establish a scam mechanism.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution's references establish promotion and recruitment language, but promotion alone does not establish a fraudulent mechanism. The evidence does not say that joining requires a deposit, that returns are guaranteed, or that every participant will profit. The distinction between recommendation income and currency-related income leaves open an ordinary referral or partner arrangement rather than proving an inherently deceptive scheme.

citations.quote: money from recommendation, it means for building the structure of people and money from One Coin itself where you can trade the currency in the internal exchange.
Registration is for free, then you will have a 10-day trial period during which you can decide if you want to join us actively.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing-deposit argument overlooks the mechanism that is actually stated. The video expressly defines one income stream as recommendations and building a structure of people, then urges viewers to become partners and join a large partner network. It also presents unlimited income, rapid growth, and a specific weekly earnings example. A scam classification need not depend on a quoted deposit requirement when recruitment-based compensation is directly described.
